rh2_recipe_install() {
  python -m pip install --no-deps pathspec==0.8.1 || return $?
  python -m pip install -e '.[all,tests]'
  local install_rc=$?
  python -I -c 'import importlib.metadata as m,json; print("RH2_DVC_DEPS="+json.dumps({x:m.version(x) for x in ['"'"'dvc'"'"']}))'
  return "$install_rc"
}
